{{Top|leg}}
A '''litigation module''' was installed in [[Caldrahlsen Mechanicals]] [[C4LR litigation droid]]. It provided the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with a comprehensive database of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] legal precedents and case histories. Specializations for the module include civil law, commerce law, taxation law, and military jurisprudence. Each droid came with one module as standard, and could accommodate up to each four additional modules.
